name: How long does it take to complete the electrical work for a typical home addition in Oakland?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete the electrical work for a typical home addition in Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for electrical work on a home addition in Oakland varies widely based on the size and complexity of the addition. A small room addition might take a few days of concentrated electrical work, while a multi-story addition with a new kitchen and bathrooms could span several weeks, often in phases as construction progresses. We coordinate closely with other trades to ensure efficient scheduling and minimize disruptions, providing a clear timeline in our project proposal.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of electrical work for a home addition in Oakland depends on its size and complexity, ranging from a few days to several weeks.
